input.goal: Create self-contained index.html: interactive full-viewport canvas orbital particle simulation with glassmorphism HUD.
input.request:
Create a single self-contained file index.html implementing an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913):
1. Responsive full-window <canvas> using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling.
2. Central glowing star using createRadialGradient and a subtle corona pulse.
3. At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, colors, at least 3 moons/satellites, and fading orbital trails.
4. Twinkling background starfield with at least 150 stars.
5. Interactive glassmorphism HUD overlay with:
   - Play/Pause toggle button
   - Trails ON/OFF toggle button
   - Reset button
   - Speed range slider (<input type="range" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">) with live multiplier readout
   - Live FPS, simulation time (s), and active burst particle count
6. Clicking anywhere on the canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out.
Keep everything self-contained in index.html with zero external dependencies and valid JavaScript syntax.

Usa Tandem.
constraints: Single file index.html, inline <style> and <script>, no external URLs, fonts, or libraries.
html, body: margin 0, overflow hidden, background #060913; canvas id="sim" fixed at 0,0 with width 100vw, height 100vh, display block.

Canvas backing size = innerWidth*devicePixelRatio by innerHeight*devicePixelRatio; ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0); recompute on window resize; center = (innerWidth/2, innerHeight/2). Orbit radii scale by s = min(innerWidth, innerHeight)/900 (clamped min 0.45).

Main loop via requestAnimationFrame; dt in seconds clamped to max 0.05; sim dt = dt*speed when playing, 0 when paused (starfield twinkle and burst particles keep animating even when paused? No: bursts freeze when paused; starfield twinkle continues).
Each frame clear the full canvas with fillStyle #060913.

Starfield: 220 stars, random positions in CSS px, radius 0.3-1.6 px, base alpha 0.3-0.9, twinkle alpha = base*(0.55+0.45*sin(t*freq+phase)) with freq 0.5-3 rad/s; color #ffffff or slight tint #cfe0ff; regenerate on resize.

Star: radius 34*s at center; core radial gradient from #ffffff (0) to #fff4c2 (0.35) to #ffb347 (0.7) to rgba(255,140,40,0) (1) over radius 34*s*1.0; corona radial gradient radius = 34*s*(2.6 + 0.25*sin(realTime*1.6)), colors rgba(255,200,90,0.35) at 0 to rgba(255,120,40,0) at 1, drawn with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter'.

Planets (exactly 6), each {name, orbit radius (base px before scale), size px, color, angular speed rad/s, initial angle}: Mercurio 80, 4, #b5b5b5, 1.6, 0; Venere 125, 7, #e8c27a, 1.15, 1.2; Terra 175, 8, #4fa3ff, 0.9, 2.4; Marte 230, 6, #ff6b4a, 0.7, 3.6; Giove 310, 15, #e0a96d, 0.42, 4.8; Saturno 390, 12, #f3d98b, 0.3, 0.6. Saturno draws a ring ellipse (radiusX size*2.1, radiusY size*0.7, strokeStyle rgba(243,217,139,0.6), lineWidth 2).
Planet angle += speed*simDt; drawn as filled circle with radial gradient (lighter color offset toward the star, darker away) plus shadowBlur 12 in planet color.
Faint orbit guide circles for each planet: strokeStyle rgba(255,255,255,0.06), lineWidth 1.

Moons (exactly 4): Luna around Terra (dist 16, size 2.2, #dddddd, speed 3.2); Phobos around Marte (dist 12, size 1.6, #c9a27e, speed 4.5); Io around Giove (dist 26, size 2.6, #f5e27a, speed 2.6); Europa around Giove (dist 36, size 2.2, #cfe7ff, speed 1.9). Moon distances scale by s too.

Trails: each planet and moon keeps array of last positions (max 60 for planets, 30 for moons), pushed every frame when sim advanced; drawn as line segments where segment i alpha = (i/len)*0.5 and lineWidth 1.5 in the body's color. When trails OFF, trails are not drawn and arrays are cleared.

Bursts: click (pointerdown) on canvas spawns 60 particles at click point (CSS px), angle evenly spaced plus random jitter ±0.1 rad, speed random 80-260 px/s, life 1.2-2.0 s, size 1.5-3.5 px, hue random from a base hue per burst (random 0-360) ±25, drawn with 'lighter' composite and radial glow (shadowBlur 10). Each sim step: vx,vy *= Math.pow(0.12, simDt) (damping), pos += v*simDt, life -= simDt; alpha = life/maxLife; remove when life <= 0.

HUD: div id="hud" fixed top 16px left 16px, width 260px, padding 14px 16px, background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter blur(14px) saturate(140%) (plus -webkit- prefix), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 16px, box-shadow 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), color #e6ecff, font 13px system-ui, sans-serif, z-index 10. Title 'Orbital Sim' 15px weight 600.

HUD buttons in a row with 8px gap: #btnPlay (text 'Pausa' when playing, 'Play' when paused), #btnTrails (text 'Scie: ON' / 'Scie: OFF'), #btnReset (text 'Reset'). Button style: background rgba(255,255,255,0.12), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22), color #e6ecff, border-radius 10px, padding 6px 10px, cursor pointer; hover background rgba(255,255,255,0.22).
Slider: <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0"> with label 'Velocità' and readout span #speedVal showing e.g. '1.0x' (value.toFixed(1)+'x'), updated on input event.

Stats lines: 'FPS: ' span #fps (integer, updated every 0.5 s using frame count average), 'Tempo: ' span #simTime (simTime.toFixed(1)+' s'), 'Particelle: ' span #particles (active burst particle count integer). Updated each frame (fps every 0.5 s).
Reset: simTime=0, all planet/moon angles to initial values, trails cleared, burst particles cleared, speed slider set to 1.0 and readout '1.0x', playing=true. Does not change trails toggle.
Clicks on the HUD must not spawn bursts (HUD is a separate element above the canvas; only canvas listens).

Expose window.app = {state:{playing, trails, speed, simTime}, planets (array, each with name, angle, trail array), moons (array), particles (array), spawnBurst(x,y), reset()}; state is the live object mutated by the sim.

content.text:
I built `index.html` with Tandem. The first run ran out of time with six requirements it couldn't show evidence for. After one follow-up hint, it passed every local check, including a browser test of the buttons, the slider, click bursts and reset. I haven't opened the page myself.

It's a single file with no external dependencies. It has:
- a pulsing central star
- 6 planets, with Saturn's ring
- 4 moons
- fading orbit trails
- 220 twinkling background stars
- click-to-spawn particle bursts that slow down and fade out
- the glass-style HUD with Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF, Reset, the 0.2–3.0 speed slider with its readout, and live FPS, time and particle count

The planet and moon names and the HUD text are in Italian, so the buttons read "Pausa"/"Play", "Scie: ON/OFF" and "Reset". Reset also puts the speed back to 1.0x but leaves the trails setting as it was.
